identity.title: [v0.92.1][V3-D11] Approve platform commit matrix and Windows posture

values.summary: Convert V3-02's measured platform-commit recommendation into a separate authorized Decision 11 record that fixes the mutation/read-only posture for every supported platform before storage work.

steps.action: Verify terminal V3-02 evidence and recompute every cited platform measurement and artifact digest.
Compare candidate commit primitives against atomic replacement, durability, recovery, and filesystem-capability requirements for every supported platform.
Choose and document the Windows posture as equivalently proven mutation or stable fail-closed read-only operation.
Record the authorized Decision 11, exact evidence references, approved matrix, and explicit non-authority of the prior recommendation.
Prove V3-08 remains blocked without this terminal record and stop on ambiguous or unmeasured semantics.
Remove decision-analysis scratch files, retain the authorized matrix and cited measurement digests, and verify V3-08 remains blocked until terminal handoff.

invariants: Issue V3-D11 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
No unsupported completion, legal, production, or release claim
No mutation outside exact owned paths
risks: A passing artifact could overstate production, legal, or release authority.
Path or external-account overlap could collide with another active issue.
Evidence could become stale if it is not tied to exact revisions and producer outcomes.
stop_conditions: A supported platform lacks measured semantics
The decision is not issued by authorized operator review
